measurements.name: Jutland Current
measurements.range_interpretation: One site-specific width description attributed to satellite imagery. Not a dated image diagnosis, paired velocity width, confidence interval, annual extrema or range across sites; no midpoint selected.
measurements.geographic_scope: Off Thyboron, Jutland Coastal Current, eastern North Sea / Skagerrak; geographic section coordinates not extracted.
measurements.section_orientation: Reported satellite-image current breadth at a named coastal site; no flow-normal transect orientation recovered.
measurements.layer: Satellite-image description; measurement depth not recovered. Mixed-water and local bathymetry context do not fix a width layer.
measurements.time_convention: Undated image-derived estimate summarized in the April 1999 thesis reprinted October 2000, citing Aarup 1994a. Publication and hydrographic-study years are not width occupation dates.
measurements.boundary_rule: Author-reported width attributed to satellite imagery; image classification threshold, sensor and exact edge rule not recovered.
measurements.source_citation: Nielsen, Mads Hvid (2000), Dynamisk beskrivelse og hydrografisk klassifikation af Den Jyske Kyststrom, DMI Scientific Report 00-15, ISBN 87-7478-425-0. Reprint of April 1999 University of Copenhagen master thesis; reprint preface October 2000.

measurements.extraction_method: Danish width sentence translated and numerals/site order transcribed from visually inspected original prose. No original Aarup image acquisition or contour digitization.
measurements.source_quality_note: Inspected original thesis cites Aarup (1994a) for image widths. Sensor, image dates, threshold, uncertainty and paired edges unresolved. Hydrographic and wind analyses are separate support; no pooled seasonal interval.
remaining_gates: Recover Aarup (1994a), Havforskning 42, imagery, sensor, dates and width definition.
